messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary health degraded for rollout r2026 in us-west-2. Error rate increased to ~4.8% (5xx/latency). Triggering on-call page.

alex: noticing 502 spike on canary tasks, tailing logs now. Frontend reports aborted streams.

ravi: digging into model-serving container logs — seeing `kv-cache init failed` and OOM-kill traces. Might be a new quantization path regression.

oncall-bot: paging @alex @ravi @liz for incident. Priority: high, impact: partial (canary).

alex: pausing rollout in the console - canary traffic set to 0%. Confirmed stop.

liz: thanks. @alex confirm you paused, @ravi any quick mitigation before we flip kill-switch?

ravi: pausing helped but some canary replicas still flapping. I recommend toggling feature flag `use_kv_cache_v2` OFF as immediate kill-switch; that will route canary to v1 codepath.

alex: executed flag toggle: `ff toggle use_kv_cache_v2 --env=us-west-2 --off` —console shows change propagated.

sara: seeing reduced error rate on the canary after flag off, 5xx down to ~0.6% within 30s. Good sign.

michael: notifying CS — affected customers on staging/test clusters only, no known production customer impact yet. Sending brief to #customer-success.

ravi: preparing rollback of canary image to previous build. Planned command:

```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=model-serving --to-image=model-serving:2.14.1 --cluster=us-west-2 --namespace=redwood-canary
```

alex: run the rollback but do a staggered drain: scale down new pods to 0 with `kubectl scale` then bring up 2.14.1.

ravi: started rollback now. Watch logs: `kubectl -n redwood-canary get pods -w`.

oncall-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-2026-1820001111, state: mitigation in progress.

liz: shifting liaison to me for the next handoff window. @alex please add an ops summary before you log off.

alex: summary: root cause likely regression in V2 KV cache path triggered by a quantization change in the new image causing memory pressure -> OOM -> 502s. Immediate mitigation: paused rollout + toggled feature flag `use_kv_cache_v2` off -> errors dropped. Rollback to 2.14.1 in progress.

sara: CS update posted: "We observed degraded canary behavior during a rollout; rollout paused and mitigations applied. No production customer impact identified. We will follow up if anything changes."

michael: I'll keep monitoring customer telemetry to catch any delayed effects.

ravi: rollback completed on canary; pods stabilized on 2.14.1, error rate back to baseline 0.1%. Running additional smoke tests.

liz: great. I'm taking over incident timeline and postmortem coordination. Next steps: collect logs, pin failing image, reproduce locally with config used in canary, add guard to canary gating (memory limit checks + perf test), and coordinate rollback for any targeted dedicated pools if we see signs.

alex: adding reproduction notes to the incident thread and linking failing job logs (s3://redwood-logs/incident-1820001111/).

oncall-bot: reminder: if you need to escalate to SRE lead, react with :pager:.

liz: I'm going to perform a formal handoff to the PM and SRE leads at 15:30 UTC. If anyone spots customer-facing regressions, ping me directly.

ravi: will run the quantization A/B with memory profiler tomorrow and open PR to revert the change until we have a fix.

michael: closing loop with CS — posted follow-up note and asked them to flag any customers seeing spikes.

liz: thanks all — incident status: mitigated, canary rolled back, ownership: liz (incident lead) -> will draft postmortem and assign action items.

alex: logging off, leaving notes in the incident doc. Good job team. :thumbsup:
